text_block_list.text:
Special Week doesn't seem to be feeling 
very well...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, I've got a bit of a 
headache~... I wonder why."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's because I had a dream about 
eating tasty food and went back to sleep 
three times...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Or is it because I ate way too much ice 
cream sharing it with El-chan and the 
others...!?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer... There are so many 
possibilities that I honestly don't know 
which one caused it...!

"And so, Special Week was troubled by a 
headache..."
